arxiv-1905-07879.title: Origin and Status of Low-Mass Candidate Hypervelocity Stars
arxiv-1905-07879.creator: Bum-Suk Yeom, Young Sun Lee, Jae-Rim Koo, Timothy C. Beers, Young Kwang Kim
arxiv-1905-07879.description: Abstract \jkashead 1 Introduction Hypervelocity stars (HVSs) are unbound and rare fast-moving objects in the Galactic halo, possessing space velocities that exceed the Galactic escape speed. The first HVS was discovered from a radial velocity survey of faint blue horizontal branch stars ( Brown et al. 2005 ) .

arxiv-2011-15071.title: PDE Comparison Principles for Robin Problems
arxiv-2011-15071.creator: Jeffrey J. Langford
arxiv-2011-15071.description: Abstract . We compare the solutions of two Poisson problems in a spherical shell with Robin boundary conditions, one with given data, and one where the data has been cap symmetrized. When the Robin parameters are nonnegative, we show that the solution to the symmetrized problem has larger convex means.

arxiv-2106-09134.title: An Arecibo 327 MHz Search for Radio Pulsars and Bursts in the Dwarf Irregular Galaxies Leo A and T
arxiv-2106-09134.creator: Fronefield Crawford, Kohei Hayashi
arxiv-2106-09134.description: Abstract We have conducted an Arecibo 327 MHz search of two dwarf irregular galaxies in the Local Group, Leo A and T, for radio pulsars and single pulses from fast radio bursts and other giant pulse emitters. We detected no astrophysical signals in this search, and we estimate flux density limits on both periodic and burst emission.

arxiv-2106-12075.title: A Hybrid Genetic-Fuzzy Controller for a 14-inches Astronomical Telescope Tracking
arxiv-2106-12075.creator: Doaa Eid 1,∗, Abdel-Fattah Attia 2, Said Elmasry 3 and Islam Helmy 1
arxiv-2106-12075.description: Abstract The performance of on telescope depend strongly on its operating conditions. During pointing the telescope can move at a relatively high velocity, and the system can tolerate trajectory position errors higher than during tracking. On the contrary, during tracking Alt-Az telescopes generally move slower but still in a large dynamic range.

arxiv-2212-02827.title: Political Honeymoon Effect on Social Media: Characterizing Social Media Reaction to the Changes of Prime Minister in Japan Conference: 15th ACM Web Science Conference 2023; April 30-May 1, 2023; Austin, TX, USA 15th ACM Web Science Conference 2023 (WebSci ’23), April 30-May 1, 2023, Evanston, TX, US
arxiv-2212-02827.creator: Kunihiro Miyazaki, Taichi Murayama, Akira Matsui, Masaru Nishikawa, Takayuki Uchiba, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An
arxiv-2212-02827.description: Abstract . New leaders in democratic countries typically enjoy high approval ratings immediately after taking office. This phenomenon is called the honeymoon effect and is regarded as a significant political phenomenon; however, its mechanism remains underexplored. Therefore, this study examines how social media users respond to changes in political leadership in order to better understand the honeymoon effect in politics.

arxiv-2407-10954.title: A Unified Differentiable Boolean Operator with Fuzzy Logic
arxiv-2407-10954.creator: Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Maneesh Agrawala, Cem Yuksel, Tim Omernick, Vinith Misra, Stefano Corazza, Morgan McGuire, Victor Zordan
arxiv-2407-10954.description: Abstract . This paper presents a unified differentiable boolean operator for implicit solid shape modeling using Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG). Traditional CSG relies on min , max operators to perform boolean operations on implicit shapes. But because these boolean operators are discontinuous and discrete in the choice of operations, this makes optimization over the CSG representation challenging.

arxiv-2512-22336.title: Agent2World : Learning to Generate Symbolic World Models via Adaptive Multi-Agent Feedback
arxiv-2512-22336.creator: Mengkang Hu Bowei Xia Yuran Wu Ailing Yu Yude Zou Qiguang Chen, Shijian Wang Jiarui Jin Kexin Li Wenxiang Jiao Yuan Lu Ping Luo
arxiv-2512-22336.description: Abstract Symbolic world models (e.g., PDDL domains or executable simulators) are central to model-based planning, but training LLMs to generate such world models is limited by the lack of large-scale verifiable supervision. Current approaches rely primarily on static validation methods that fail to catch behavior-level errors arising from interactive execution.

pmc-10650209.title: Identification of Polyphenols in Sea Fennel (Crithmum maritimum) and Seaside Arrowgrass (Triglochin maritima) Extracts with Antioxidant, ACE-I, DPP-IV and PEP-Inhibitory Capacity
pmc-10650209.creator: Marta María Calvo, María Elvira López-Caballero, Oscar Martínez-Alvarez
pmc-10650209.description: Sea fennel and seaside arrowgrass are two abundant but underutilized halophytes along the Atlantic and Mediterranean coasts. This study investigated the antioxidant capacity and the potential antihypertensive (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme I, ACE-I inhibition), hypoglycaemic (Dipeptidyl Peptidase IV, DPP-IV inhibition), and nootropic (Prolyl Endopeptidase, PEP inhibition) activity of their polyphenol extracts.

pmc-11465578.title: Two Different Responsive Organosilica Nanocarriers to Combine Chemo- and Immunotherapy against Cancer
pmc-11465578.creator: Maria Sancho-Albero, Alessia Lucrezia Fenaroli, Mirco Scaccaglia, Cristina Matteo, Chiara Grasselli, Massimo Zucchetti, Roberta Frapolli, Claudia Nastasi, Luisa De Cola
pmc-11465578.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The combination of chemo- and immunotherapy was recently demonstrated to improve a patient’s response to therapy, giving rise to an emerging cancer treatment known as chemoimmunotherapy (CIT). Despite the promising benefits of CIT, the most important challenges are (i) the simultaneous or time-controlled delivery of two drugs and (ii) the selective uptake into different cells for each of the drugs: cancer cells for the chemotherapeutic and macrophages for the immunostimulation actives.

pmc-11472127.title: The Impact of Shiatsu Massage on Labour Pain and Anxiety: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11472127.creator: Hestri Norhapifah, Mohamad Rodi Isa, Bahiyah Abdullah, Salina Mohamed
pmc-11472127.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Labour pain experienced by women during childbirth can significantly affect the mother’s psychological condition and birthing process. This study aimed to determine the effect of shiatsu massage on pain and anxiety during labour.Method: This randomized controlled trial was conducted on 80 nulliparous pregnant women who gave birth in four low-risk maternity clinics in Samarinda, Indonesia, from February to May 2022. The women were randomized into intervention (N=40) and control (N=40) groups based on random allocation.

pmc-11647077.title: Rare case of classic Hodgkin lymphoma in a patient with ulcerative colitis
pmc-11647077.creator: Nicole Allyson Chua, Jose Sollano Jr
pmc-11647077.description: SummaryPrimary gastrointestinal tract lymphoma (PGIL) is a rare form of presentation of gastrointestinal tract (GI) lymphomas. Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and the use of thiopurines are known risk factors for its appearance. We report a male patient in his early 70s treated only with mesalamine for ulcerative colitis (UC) for the past 6 years.

pmc-12505950.title: Efficacy of structured teaching program for rehabilitation of children with autism spectrum disorder: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12505950.creator: Yinfang Zhu, Manyan Zhang, Dandan Ma, Pingping Wang
pmc-12505950.description: Background & Objective:The Structured Teaching Program, based on the Treatment and Education of Autistic and Related Communication Handicapped Children (TEACCH) program approach, has been a cornerstone in the educational rehabilitation of children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). This study assesses the efficacy of structured teaching program in managing ASD children.

pmc-12603430.title: Efficacy and safety of datopotamab deruxtecan in advanced/metastatic non-small cell lung cancer patients: a systematic review and single-arm meta-analysis
pmc-12603430.creator: Henrique Kim, Paulo Victor Zattar Ribeiro, Álvaro Lopes de Oliveira, Helano Carioca Freitas, Vladmir Cláudio Cordeiro de Lima
pmc-12603430.description: BackgroundDatopotamab deruxtecan (dato-DXd), an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting trophoblast cell-surface antigen 2 (TROP2), has shown promising results in advanced/metastatic (a/m) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the efficacy and safety of dato-DXd in this population.
